content: November 14, 2024 Grants and Funding What to know NCEZID offers funding opportunities for programs that advance the mission to protect people in the United States and abroad from emerging and zoonotic infectious diseases. Featured funding One important funding support for state health departments is the Epidemiology and Laboratory Capacity cooperative agreement. This serves as a primary support mechanism for communicable diseases work at the state level. The Epidemiology and Laboratory Capacity (ELC) Program ELC provides financial and technical support to detect, prevent, and respond to emerging diseases. Nov. 16, 2023 Current funding opportunities Visit CDC's Funding site for a full list of NCEZID funding opportunities and to learn more about how to engage with these opportunities.
